lines.text: Si fuerit in decimo significat claritatem patris eius iuxta
lines.en: If it is in the tenth, it signifies the renown of his father near

lines.text: principes, & in operibus principum erit.
lines.en: princes, and he will be in the works of princes.

lines.text: Si fuerit in undecimo, habebit bonitatem ab amicis.
lines.en: If it is in the eleventh, he will have goodness from friends.

lines.text: Si fuerit in duodecimo, erit malum patris eius & propin-
lines.en: If it is in the twelfth, it will be the evil of his father and of his

lines.text: quorum.
lines.en: relatives.

lines.text: CAPVT XII. DE SIGNIFICATIONE
lines.en: CHAPTER XII. ON THE SIGNIFICATION

lines.text: domini quinti in duodecim domibus.
lines.en: of the lord of the fifth in the twelve houses.

lines.text: SI fuerit dominus quinti in ascendente habebit fortunam
lines.en: IF the lord of the fifth is in the ascendant, he will have fortune

lines.text: à filijs & amicis.
lines.en: from sons and friends.

lines.text: Si fuerit in secundo, habebit fratres in peregrinatione, &
lines.en: If it is in the second, he will have brothers in travel, and

lines.text: habebit lucrum à filijs suis.
lines.en: he will have profit from his sons.

lines.text: Si fuerit in tertio, à mulieribus habebit fortunam.
lines.en: If it is in the third, he will have fortune from women.

lines.text: Si fuerit in quarto, pater eius erit diues in substantia, &
lines.en: If it is in the fourth, his father will be rich in substance, and

lines.text: longæ uitæ, & uidebit filios filiorum suorum.
lines.en: of long life, and he will see the sons of his sons.

lines.text: Si fuerit in quinto, filij eius bonitatem, & bonam uitam
lines.en: If it is in the fifth, his sons will have goodness, and a good life,

lines.text: habebunt, & erunt nominati.
lines.en: and they will be renowned.

lines.text: Si fuerint in sexto, filij eius habebunt multum languorẽ,
lines.en: If they are in the sixth, his sons will have much illness,

lines.text: & erunt debilis uitæ.
lines.en: and they will be of weak life.

lines.text: Si fuerit in septimo, accipiet uxorem maiorem se, & ha-
lines.en: If it is in the seventh, he will take a wife older than himself, and he will

lines.text: bebit bonitatem & multam substantiam.
lines.en: have goodness and much substance.

lines.text: Si fuerit in octauo, filij eius morientur in diebus suis, &
lines.en: If it is in the eighth, his sons will die in his days, and

lines.text: inueniet quasi principatum & exaltationem.
lines.en: he will find as it were a principality and exaltation.

lines.text: Si fuerit in nono, filios non generabit in terra sua.
lines.en: If it is in the ninth, he will not generate sons in his own land.

lines.text: Si fuerit in decimo, filij eius multum languorem habebũt,
lines.en: If it is in the tenth, his sons will have much illness,

lines.text: & malos dies habebit, & non inueniet mala à principibus.
lines.en: and he will have bad days, and he will not find evils from princes.

lines.text: Si fuerit in undecimo, filij eius habebunt fortunam à prin
lines.en: If it is in the eleventh, his sons will have fortune from prin-

lines.text: cipibus.
lines.en: ces.

lines.text: Si fuerit in duodecimo, significat inimicitiam filiorũ eius
lines.en: If it is in the twelfth, it signifies the enmity of his sons

lines.text: cum eo, & nunquam simul gaudebunt.
lines.en: with him, and they will never rejoice together.

lines.en: of the lord of the sixth in the twelve places.

summary.headline: Lord of the Fifth in Twelve Houses
summary.text: Astrological judgments for the lord of the fifth in the twelve houses, concerning sons, fathers, friends, marriage, wealth, illness, princes, and enmity; Chapter XIII begins with the lord of the sixth in the twelve places.
